Then put in a real address (e.g. `https://react.dev/reference/react`) and Save — the bookmark updates, and the site name follows the new address.

2. **Delete permanently:** On any bookmark, click **🗑 Delete…**. Notice it doesn't delete immediately — it asks *"Delete this bookmark permanently?"* and explicitly reminds you this is **different from archiving** and can't be undone, offering **Archive** as the gentler alternative. Click **Cancel** to back out (nothing lost), or **Delete permanently** to remove it for good.
